validation_scope: FHIR R4 structural JSON schema and JSON shape checks
additional_checks: Complex elements must be JSON objects, including singleton maximum cardinality 1.
Arrays must contain at least one item when present.
JSON numbers must be finite; NaN and positive/negative Infinity are rejected recursively.
limitations: Passing structural validation does not establish full FHIR conformance.
Profiles, FHIRPath invariants, choice exclusivity, all minimum cardinalities, terminology bindings and code membership are not comprehensively validated.
The official R4 schema has omissions; separate labeled JSON shape checks address complex object shape, empty arrays and finite JSON numbers only.
The official schema can also reject some valid FHIR JSON representations, such as null placeholders in repeating primitive value arrays; it is not a complete FHIR validator.
Schema acceptance is not a guarantee of clinical validity or suitability.
